name: Sweeper
soft_passes: #2 optically centred but runs tall (~87% canvas height); would crowd a squircle safe zone
#4 bin reads at 16px but is indistinguishable from the system Trash icon — identity collision, not smear
#6 4+ saturated hue families in contents exceed economy rule; passes only because gray vessel dominates ~70% of pixels and colour is contained to the mouth
#7 mid-gray body vs light Dock is moderate contrast; separation leans on baked shadow + rim highlight that macOS 26 strips
failures: #1 transparent background, no squircle plate — free-standing object designed for pre-Big-Sur Dock; floats unmasked on macOS 26
#10 baked specular + shadow, single flat PNG, no layer authoring; polychrome contents can't tint — no dark/clear/tinted survivability

palette.accent: none reserved (polychrome); brightest focal is app-tile blue #1CA5F2

light_model: top-down with slight front-left key; baked specular hotspot on front rim lip (#EAEBED), soft vertical body highlight, soft contact shadow beneath — all baked, not system-generated
layer_stack: card jumble: app tiles + document + photo prints
bin front wall with specular rim
devices: trash-can quote (macOS Trash silhouette as container)
overflowing mouth (contents spill above rim, front wall occludes their base)
monochrome vessel / polychrome contents (gray bin frames discarded colourful apps + photos)
rhymes_hint: pre-Big-Sur free-object utility/cleaner icons (AppCleaner, TrashMe, AppZapper, CleanMyMac-adjacent) — rendered vessel + discarded contents on transparency; skeuomorphic free-object cleaner lineage
notes: 512x512 web render (half of 1024 master) — silhouette and body ramp measured cleanly; photo-card imagery and document chart are soft/estimated. Transparent background (no squircle plate) is the strongest 'not authored for macOS 26 Liquid Glass' signal — would float plateless/unmasked in a modern Dock and breaks unison with squircle icons. Trash-can silhouette collides with the system Trash icon at Dock size (identity risk). Brand cover uses white + near-black SF + one rust-orange strikethrough accent (~#C0491F); the icon does NOT carry that brand orange, so icon-brand palette coherence is only partial. First icon in the corpus — rhymes_hint is a style-family guess, no in-corpus rhyme yet.
